title: Senior Software Engineer (FX)
description:
About Lumx

Lumx is building the stablecoin payments stack for Latin America and beyond—API-first on/off-ramps, virtual/external accounts, wallets, and compliant FX. We deliver instant settlements and institutional-grade reliability. Backed by leading partners (including BTG Pactual), we combine product excellence with security and compliance.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with advanced experience in fintech, payments, and FX to design, build, and operate existing mission-critical services that power pay-ins, pay-outs, and currency conversion (quoting, rate locks, execution, settlement). You’ll work across API design, event-driven systems, and function-orchestrated workflows, always with reliability, observability, recoverability and idempotency as first-class requirements.

What You’ll Do
  • Integrate partners fast: Ship high-quality connectors with banks, PSPs, and FX providers.
  • Own core money flows: Design and run services for pay-ins/pay-outs/FX (quoting, rate-lock, execution, netting, and settlement).
  • Raise reliability bars: Implement robust idempotency, retries/backoff, DLQs, and graceful degradation.
  • Build event-driven workflows: Orchestrate function-based workflows and long-running sagas for multi-party financial processes.
  • Model money correctly: Ensure reconciliation across entities and precise amount/rounding semantics.
  • Document & mentor: Write clear ADRs/runbooks and help level up the team through code reviews and sharing your technical knowledge.
What you bring
  • 5+ years building backend services at scale (fintech/payments/FX experience required).
  • Strong TypeScript + Node.js fundamentals; clean modular design and high-quality APIs (REST/JSON).
  • Deep understanding of event-driven architectures (queues/streams), saga patterns, and function-orchestrated flows (experience with Temporal.io is a plus).
  • Solid data fundamentals: relational modeling (PostgreSQL), transactions/consistency, and performance tuning; caching strategies.
  • Security mindset for financial systems and familiarity with regulated environments (KYC/KYB/KYT concepts).
Nice to have
  • Experience with FX & rate-locking, treasury, reconciliation at multi-entity scale.
  • Knowledge of local rails (PIX, ACH), cards, and crypto on/off-ramps.
  • Previous experience with compliance audit processes (e.g. SOC2)
How we work
  • Quality first: strong test coverage, thoughtful code reviews, security by design.
  • Ownership with context: autonomy, transparency, and tight feedback loops.
  • Very few meetings, prioritizing deep focus time blocks.
  • Competitive compensation + potential equity
  • Remote-friendly with flexible hours (Americas time zones)
  • Local holidays and supportive time-off policy
Seniority level
  • Mid-Senior level
Employment type
  • Full-time
Job function

  • Industries: Software Development

  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills.

About the Role:

As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating on the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products.

You can work remotely or in a flexible regime if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Keep in mind that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

Reporting to the Technology Director, working in the BWZ Labs Team but also closely with the Web Platform. You will be tasked with the development of internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer facing systems used by thousands of clients.

You don’t have to know all the answers, because you will have the time to research and learn new technologies and solutions, so you can make suggestions and implementations that might fit our product needs to better perform and scale.

  • You will be part of a team, collaboration is a key factor.

  • Curiosity to understand how things work.

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.

Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally.

We got our start in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

title: Consulting X-Force Incident Response Consultant Professional NO City, BR
description:
Overview

Information and Data are some of the most important organizational assets in today’s businesses. As a Security Consultant, you will be a key advisor for IBM’s clients, analysing business requirements to design and implement the best security solutions for their needs. You will apply your technical skills to find the balance between enabling and securing the client’s organization with the cognitive solutions that are making IBM the fastest growing enterprise security business in the world.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant for the IBM Security X-Force Incident Response (X-Force IR) team in Latin America, you will be responsible for the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services. You will lead a team of consultants who are responding to high profile cybersecurity incidents within our clients’ enterprise networks. You will work with our clients to proactively prevent and detect future cybersecurity incidents. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients, helping to shape their cybersecurity program. You will collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to provide integrated solutions to our clients’ most challenging problems.

  • Lead a team of consultants responding to high-profile cybersecurity incidents within clients’ enterprise networks.
  • Direct the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services in Latin America.
  • Work with clients to proactively prevent and detect cybersecurity incidents; help shape and mature their cybersecurity programs.
  • Collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to deliver integrated security solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on incident response, threat intelligence, and security program maturity.

In this role you will have demonstrated skills in various elements of Incident Response, conducting computer intrusion investigations, and have a strong foundation in cyber security policy, operations and best practices; ideally in large enterprise environments. You will have proficiency with leading EDR tools as well as familiarity with forensic analysis tools such as X-Ways, EnCase Forensic or FTK and live response analysis. Furthermore, familiarity with Windows and Linux enterprise environments and systems such as Active Directory, Office 365, FWs, IPS/IDS, SIEMs, etc. is required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. When not responding to breaches, you will conduct enterprise threat hunting, help clients develop incident response plans, facilitate tabletop and purple team exercises as well as provide other strategic security services related to incident response.

Required education

Bachelor's Degree

Required technical and professional expertise

Significant hands-on experience with hardware/software tools used in incident response, computer forensics, network security assessments, and/or application security.

  • Years Experience with assessing and developing enterprise-wide policies and procedures for IT risk mitigation and incident response.
  • Experience leading incident response teams and managing tasks across all phases of an engagement.
  • Experience managing a team of consultants with skills similar to those described below.
  • Capable of working independently as well as providing leadership on internal projects and client engagements.
Forensic Analysis & Incident Response Skills
  • Ability to forensically analyze both Windows & Unix systems for evidence of compromise.
  • Proficiency with industry standard forensic tools such as EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Sleuthkit.
  • Experience performing log analysis locally and via SIEM/log aggregation tool.
  • Experience hunting threat actors in large enterprise networks and cloud environments.
  • Experience with using and configuring Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) tools.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the behaviour, security risks and controls of common network protocols.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of common applications used in Windows and Linux enterprise environment. Familiarity with Active Directory, Exchange and Office365 applications and logs.
  • Familiarity with the tools and techniques required to analyse & reverse diverse protocols and data traversing a network environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP or Azure
  • Proficient in writing cohesive reports for a technical and non-technical audience.
Strategic Assessment Expertise
  • Examine and analyze available client internal policies, processes, and procedures to determine patterns and gaps at both a strategic and tactical levels. Recommend appropriate course of action to support maturing the client’s incident response program and cyber security posture.
  • A strong familiarity with various security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001/2, PCI DSS, NIST800-53, 800-171, and applicable data privacy laws and regulations.
  • Demonstrated experience with planning, scoping, and delivering technical and/or executive level tabletop exercises, with a focus on either tactical or strategic incident response processes.
  • Ability to incorporate current trends and develop custom scenarios applicable to a client.

• Low-level operating system knowledge, including automation and performing administrative tasks.

• Scripting or programming experience, preferably in a language commonly used for DFIR such as Python or PowerShell.

• Ability to work with data at scale such as using Splunk / ELK.

• Expertise working with shell programs such as grep, sed and awk to process data quickly.

• Working experience with virtualisation and cloud technology platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP & Azure.

• Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.

Preferred technical and professional experience
  • Diverse understanding of cyber security related vulnerabilities, common attack vectors, and mitigations.
  • Capable of developing strategic level incident response plans as well as tactical-focused playbooks.
  • Ability to manage tasks and coordinate work streams during incident response investigations.
  • Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.
ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT

IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.

YOUR LIFE @ IBM

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Being an IBMer means you’ll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you’ll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.

Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. They are trusted to provide on-going feedback to help other IBMers grow, as well as collaborate with colleagues keeping in mind a team focused approach to include different perspectives to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers. The courage our IBMers have to make critical decisions everyday is essential to IBM becoming the catalyst for progress, always embracing challenges with resources they have to hand, a can-do attitude and always striving for an outcome focused approach within everything that they do.

Are you ready to be an IBMer?

ABOUT IBM

IBM’s greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason and science, we can improve business, society and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world.

title: Well Control Instructor (Consultant)
description:
Overview

O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea). Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.

  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos em simuladores, replicando cenários reais de controle de poço (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).

  • Aplicar avaliações e exames, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade e integridade definidos pelo IADC.

  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.

  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.

  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço

  • Conhecimento Técnico: - Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) - Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento - Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

We are looking for

  • Certification: IADC WellSharp-approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.

  • Technical Knowledge: - Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) -Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing, and cementing operations -International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Languages: Advanced English (mandatory).

title: Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment
description:
Overview

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
Differentials
  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.

description:
National Associate & Regional Director

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

The National Associate & Regional Director (NARD) will support the daily operations of Howard University and the PNC National Center for Entrepreneurship (“the Center”). The NARD will play a critical leadership role in advancing the mission of the Center by supporting program strategy, partnership development, and national coordination of entrepreneurship initiatives. The NARD will collaborate with campus partners, funders, faculty, and student leaders to promote business innovation, entrepreneurship education, and venture creation.

This individual, who will report directly to the National Executive Director (NED), will serve as a critical broker between program funders, colleagues, students, the University, and the broader community. In this position, the NARD will assist the NED in managing the strategic and operations of the National Center including, working closely with Regional Directors in the center network, developing curriculum and programmatic activities, creating lecture opportunities for executives, managing and establishing relationships across the University and within varying sectors, creating program timelines, marketing of program outcomes, and any other related duties to help the success of the Center.

In addition, the NARD will assist the NED in tracking quantifiable data and statistical evidence to qualify the success of the Center. This will include tracking student and entrepreneur success and recommend ways in which improvements could be to assure the success of the Center. The NARD will also assist the NED in formally planning, assigning, directing, and coordinating the work of the Center employees.

Supervisory Accountability

The NARD will assist the NED to formally plan, assign, direct, and coordinate the work of the Center across the country. They will also assist in the management and supervision of National Center staff of professionals and support staff.

Nature And Scope

The NARD will be a university leader who will continue to drive the institution-wide culture of innovation and best practices. This leader will foster a vibrant work environment and be a trusted advisor and partner to the senior leadership team and the University community.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategic Program Development & Implementation

  • Lead the design, planning, implementation, and evaluation of national entrepreneurship programs and capacity-building initiatives with high impact on program participants
  • Coordinate with communities around the country to support local entrepreneurship center development, student programming, and faculty training
  • Provide guidance to entrepreneurship centers and incubators on program design, student engagement, and partnership cultivation
  • Ensure alignment of national programs with institutional needs, funder expectations, and impact metrics
  • Assist in the development, management, and execution of the Center’s strategic plan in collaboration with the School of Business and university administration
  • Prepare reports, financial statements, and records on program activities, progress, status, or related special reports
  • Assist in the creation and oversight of an Annual National Conference

Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support the NED in cultivating and managing strategic partnerships with corporate, nonprofit, government, and philanthropic organizations
  • Serve as a liaison between the national center and entrepreneurship leaders at participating institutions and partnering organizations
  • Work collaboratively with faculty and staff at regional centers
  • Represent the center at national conferences, summits, and convenings

Operational Leadership

Overview

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI. The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting-edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double-checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem-solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What you’ll be doing
  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause-effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage
How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements
  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications

description:

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Maqueiro – Rede Hospital Casa – Laranjeiras

Principais atividades
  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Executar o transporte de pacientes durante as transferências, encaminhamento e retorno de exames ,altas e óbitos.
  • Executar o transporte seguro de pacientes no ambiente intra-hospitalar, e equipamentos, assim como, cilindro de oxigênio, ventilador, monitor multiparametros e demais equipamentos relacionados ao transporte;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o transporte;
  • Movimentar e auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes da maca ou cadeira de rodas para o leito e vice-versa; da maca, cadeira de rodas ou cama para superfície de realização de exames em geral e vice e versa, sempre sob a supervisão do profissional de saúde;
  • Certificar-se com o Enfermeiro do setor se o paciente está liberado antes de iniciar o transporte;
  • Participar do acolhimento dos pacientes na classificação de risco, em conjunto com a Equipe de enfermagem no que tange à transferência dos pacientes para as unidades solicitadas;
  • Conhecer e manusear os equipamentos de transporte de pacientes tais como maca, cama e cadeira de rodas;
  • Movimentar cadeiras de rodas, camas e macas nas dependências da Unidade de Saúde, quando solicitado pelo Enfermeiro ou Gestor responsável;
  • Zelar pela Integridade e organização do prontuário do paciente sob seu transporte;
  • Zelar pela integridade física do paciente durante o transporte;
  • Zelar pelo bom estado do equipamento utilizado para o transporte, comunicado à equipe de enfermagem quaisquer alterações observadas e ou ocorridas com o equipamento;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa e/ou durante o transporte do paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.
Esperamos que você tenha
  • Disponibilidade total para início imediato;
  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Desejáveis Noções básicas de maqueiro.
  • Conhecer os serviços de saúde, normas de higiene ocupacional e de biossegurança. É necessário conhecer e utilizar técnicas específicas na movimentação e no transporte dos pacientes.
Oferecemos

description:
Overview

Cargo: Supervisor(a) de Negócios

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para liderar o time de Reviews Intelligence no RankMyApp, com foco em garantir a excelência operacional, a performance da equipe e entregas estratégicas que gerem alto valor para o cliente. Essa posição tem impacto direto na expansão de receita, retenção de clientes e evolução dos nossos produtos. A atuação envolve a gestão integrada de pessoas, processes e produto, assegurando o atingimento dos OKRs e metas da área, sempre com olhar analítico, foco em melhoria contínua e liderança inspiradora.

Responsibilities
  • Liderar unidades de negócio compostas por account, assistentes e analistas de operação e sucesso do cliente B2B, além de RevOps.
  • Conduzir reuniões de 1:1, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDIs).
  • Realizar controle de ponto, acompanhamento de performance e metas (individuais e de equipe).
  • Apoiar processos de recrutamento, seleção e onboarding (entrevistas, cases, fechamentos de vaga).
  • Definir e acompanhar os projetos trimestrais (planejamento e execução).
  • Acompanhar, reportar e garantir a entrega de KPIs como revenue churn, net churn, MRR, ticket médio, upsell, cross-sell, margem operacional etc.
  • Realizar fechamentos gerenciais e operacionais (projetos, comissões, bônus, freelancers, OKRs e metas nível área e nível individual).
  • Supervisionar as entregas aos clientes.
  • Mapear melhorias, acompanhar benchmarks e propor inovações que agreguem valor aos clientes e à receita.
  • Garantir ações de relacionamento com foco em retenção e expansão de receita e também ações de recuperação de clientes e prevenção de churn com base em Health Score.
  • Realizar visitas presenciais.
  • Conduzir apresentações gerenciais estratégicas.
  • Mapear e manter relacionamento com decisores.
  • Assegurar o ciclo completo de relacionamento com o cliente: handoff, onboarding, acompanhamento, renovação etc.
  • Garantir atualização de dados no CRM.
  • Monitorar CSAT e traçar planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (oral e escrita) e expertise em negociações.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Critérios obrigatórios:
    • Residir em São Paulo ou regiões próximas para realização de visitas presenciais e participação em eventos quando necessário;
    • Capacidade de transformar dados em ações táticas e estratégicas;
    • Experiência com contas B2B Enterprise, especialmente com foco em expansão de receita;
    • Vivência com estratégias de retenção de clientes e crescimento de receita;
    • Capacidade analítica forte e domínio de indicadores de receita e experiência do cliente (MRR, churn, upsell, CSAT, Health Score etc.);
    • Atuação prévia com feedbacks de clientes via app stores, Reclame Aqui, NPS e CSAT;
    • Perfil prático, com senso de urgência, organização e capacidade de gerar valor aos clientes;
    • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário comercial com fluidez e agilidade na comunicação com o time, liderança e clientes;
    • Saber conduzir reuniões remotas com organização, clareza e foco em resultado (não basta ser bom só no presencial);
    • Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes multidisciplinares (CS, operações, atendimento, RevOps);
    • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM, planilhas avançadas, plataformas de BI e indicadores de performance;
    • Familiaridade com frameworks como OKRs, PDIs e metodologias ágeis;
    • Vivência em ambientes de rápido crescimento ou tech startups com high touch.
Diferenciais
  • Inglês/Espanhol intermediário;
  • Background ou conhecimentos em marketing digital e mídia de performance;
  • Conhecimento em HubSpot.
Informações adicionais
  • O que nos comprometemos para desenvolver sua carreira:
    • Promovemos autonomia e espaço para você se desenvolver;
    • Ações de capacitações e feedbacks constantes;
    • Ter liberdade de ser quem você é;
    • 1:1s quinzenais com seu gestor;
    • Plano de desenvolvimento individual;
    • Avaliações 360° duas vezes por ano.

Faça parceria com os melhores

O Engenheiro de Teste Senior será responsável por desenvolver documentos de testes de engenharia mecânica, analisar dados, executar ("on hands") e acompanhar testes de qualificação, observando as normas API 17B, Petrobras I-ETs dentre outras. Atuará junto com os departamentos envolvidos na coleta, organização de informações e desenvolvimento dos documentos de teste, especificações e relatórios de teste.

Como Engenheiro de Teste Senior , você será responsável por:

  • Participar de elaboração de projetos de equipamentos de testes que podem consistir em instrumentação, sistemas de controle, sistemas hidráulicos, sistemas térmicos e sistemas de pressão;
  • Fornecer liderança técnica para o processo de qualificação;
  • Formular e implementar planos para alcançar exigências técnicas, cronogramas e compromissos contratuais;
  • Fornecer liderança técnica para outros funcionários e atribuídos;
  • Monitorar e comunicar o status do projeto, questões comerciais e desenvolvimentos significativos;
  • Participar do planejamento e execução de testes, relacionando-se com os técnicos;
  • Atuar na compra de materiais e acessórios utilizando os softwares internos;
  • Analisar resultados de testes e redigir relatórios técnicos, além de determinar documentação, procedimentos e relatórios de testes;
  • Prover suporte técnico em engenharia aos engenheiros de testes e assistir os técnicos nas atividades de seleção de equipamentos, materiais e processos requeridos nos testes de qualificação;
  • Elaborar respostas técnicas ao cliente quanto às especificações e resultados de testes;
  • Integrar grupo multidisciplinar para o desenvolvimento de técnicas de ensaio não convencionais em pequena, média e grande escala;
  • Trabalhar e assegurar a conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da empresa relativos à Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, assegurando que sejam praticados por colaboradores, fornecedores e terceiros, reportando qualquer não-conformidade, acidente, incidente ou potenciais situações de risco e interrompendo eventuais situações inseguras ou prejudiciais ao meio ambiente, a saúde e a segurança, baseado em atitude, treinamento, liderança e comprometimento.
Alimente sua paixão

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisa:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica ou Metalúrgica com registro no CREA.
  • Experiência na área de testes de qualificação de dutos flexíveis;
  • Experiência em sensores de instrumentação tais como: válvulas, LVDT, transdutores de pressão, sensores de temperatura, inclinômetros, acelerômetros e strain gauges;
  • Experiência com aquisição de dados;
  • Experiência com a execução de testes de pequena, média e grande escala;
  • Compreensão dos sistemas de tubulação flexíveis, design de equipamentos auxiliares e de manuseio e métodos de instalação;
  • Inglês fluente, Pacote Office, leitura e interpretação de desenhos;
  • Desejável possuir habilidade em SolidWorks ou Inventor;
  • Power BI e Python são diferenciais;
  • Forte aptidão técnica, incluindo ferramentas e sistemas de engenharia aplicáveis;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Capacidade de orientar e influenciar os outros;
  • Forte orientação do processo na abordagem do trabalho;
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de liderança;
  • Capacidade de influenciar os outros e criar grupos coesos.

Reconhecemos que cada pessoa é diferente e que a maneira como as pessoas desejam trabalhar e oferecer o melhor é diferente para cada pessoa também. Nesta função, podemos oferecer os seguintes padrões de trabalho flexíveis:

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.


O time deInteraction Platform:

O time de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas (Ex: mobile, web, terminais, conversacionais) e os padrões de experiência globais através do design system, viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer Mobile Sr.

Você terá um papel de grande influência técnica no time, com a missão de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento, que irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, com atuação "hands on" onde precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, atuará no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone.

Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

O que esperamos de você:
  • Ter interesse em trabalhar com adoção de novas tecnologias e aprender mais sobre KMP;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Experiência em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI/CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e/ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.
O que aumenta as suas chances:
  • Conhecimentos em KMP - Kotlin Multiplataforma
  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI/UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e/ou apps de larga escala;

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
